question_text: A regional academic medical center has 10 cases of adenovirus in the span of a week among its ICU patients. A committee is formed to investigate this outbreak. They are tasked with identifying the patients and interviewing the care providers to understand how adenovirus could have been spread from patient to patient. This committee will review charts, talk to the care provider teams, and investigate current patient safety and sanitation measures in the ICU. The goal of the committee is to identify weaknesses in the current system and to put in place a plan to help prevent this sort of outbreak from reoccurring in the future. The committee is most likely using what type of analysis?
